subject: Cognitive Science
title: First Principles Thinking
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: First Principles Thinking.

hook.text: Everyone said batteries cost $600 per kWh. Elon Musk asked what the raw materials cost. Answer: $80.

buildup.text: First principles thinking strips away assumptions and reduces a problem to its fundamental truths.

discovery.text: Aristotle defined it: a first principle is the most basic truth that cannot be deduced from anything else.

twist.text: It's cognitively expensive. Most daily decisions should use analogy. Reserve first principles for big bets.

climax.text: When everyone is reasoning by analogy, first principles thinkers see possibilities others can't.

punchline.text: Break it down to what's actually true.

quiz.question: What is first principles thinking?
options: Breaking problems down to fundamental truths
